        s = 0

        return matrix[depot][v]  # unused

        # cost from depot to both ends for quick check if needed

            return 0, 0
        return matrix[depot][route[0]], matrix[depot][route[-1]]

            dist += matrix[depot][r[0]]

        i = cl[a_i]

            j = cl[b_i]
            s = matrix[depot][i] + matrix[depot][j] - matrix[i][j]
            cand.append((s, i, j))
    cand.sort(key=lambda t: (-t[0], t[1], t[2]))

    # merge end of route containing i with start of route containing j, or vice versa, when those are true ends
